head: codex/5697-chronosense-trusted-time
title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3] Route Chronosense through trusted_time authority
body:
Closes #5697

Routes production Runtime v3 Chronosense through the recorder-backed trusted_time authority instead of direct SystemTime reads. Chronosense now fails closed while trusted_time is unqualified, returns monotonic qualified time once available, declares a readiness/control dependency on trusted_time, and preserves trusted_time < Chronosense < Scheduler startup ordering with focused assembly/governed-operation tests and strict Clippy evidence. Exact pre-PR review passed with no findings.
